svg.title: Laughlin quasihole density: Fulsebakke et al. (2023), Figure 11(a)
svg.desc: Electron-density profile of a Laughlin quasihole at filling one third, for finite spherical systems and a thermodynamic extrapolation. Cropped from Figure 11(a), doi:10.21468/SciPostPhys.14.6.149. Jørgen Fulsebakke, Mikael Fremling, Niall Moran and J. K. Slingerland; CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Curves and labels unchanged; converted from the vector PDF.
